schema.description: A specification of the allocation of an emission quantity to a specific organization.
schema.title: Organization Emission Allocation

organization_emission_allocation_percent.description: A numeric field representing the portion of the total emissions allocated to an organization, expressed as a decimal value (e.g., 0.25 for 25%). This defines the share of responsibility or ownership attributed to the organization within the emission report.

organization_id.description:
The Foreign Key linking the emission allocation record to the corresponding Organization entity in the master data.

It identifies the organization that receives a portion of the total emissions allocation within a reporting structure. This linkage ensures accountability and traceability of allocated emissions for the organization’s reporting, assurance, or disclosure obligations under standards such as ISO 14064‑1 and GHG Protocol.

id.description: The Primary Key that uniquely identifies an organization emission allocation record. It serves as the main reference for linking allocation data within emission reporting processes.

emission_statement_id.description: A Foreign Key referencing the specific Emission Statement associated with this allocation. It identifies from which verified Emission Statement the organization’s allocation is drawn.

id.description: Unique identifier of an OSDU record.

version.description: Version number of this OSDU record.
